title: SPECIAL RULES FOR MANHATTAN CORE PARKING FACILITIES
previewText: All accessory off-street parking facilities, automobile rental establishments, and public parking lots developed, enlarged or extended in the Manhattan Core after May 8, 2013, shall comply with the applicable provisions of this Section, inclusive.
